name: [🎉RELEASE] Pixel Incremental 2 🍀
desc:
🍀  Welcome to Pixel Inc 2! 

⏫ Collect Pixels!
✨ Farm for Rare Pixels with amazing auras and musics!
🍀 Roll your tier to progress!
💰 Buy Upgrades to boost your progression and unlock new features!

🗓️  Join the community server for codes that give permanent boosts, or to be notified about the updates!
✔️ Weekly updates 

🗓️ Update log [Update 5]:

-More Galaxy Upgrades
-Balance Changes
-Color Upgrades
-Bugs Fixed

⭐ Like and Favorite the game for more updates!

If your game is laggy, play in a private server or disable pop-ups and pixel collect VFX in settings!

💙 Thanks for playing!
